name: Nopales
description: Prickly pear pads with the spines scraped off — slightly slimy, faintly sour.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; a desert succulent; read as cooling and moistening.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; shita and mucilaginous, like okra.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with the cooling succulents.
